tools.name: search_linkedin

tools.name: linkedin_person_posts
tools.description: Get recent posts authored by a LinkedIn person by profile URL or public slug. Returns posts with engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares, reactions), author info, images, videos, and articles.

tools.name: linkedin_post_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific LinkedIn post by URL. Returns full post text, author details, and engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares, reaction breakdowns).

tools.name: linkedin_company_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a LinkedIn company page by URL. Returns company name, description, employee count, locations, specialities, industry, website, and similar companies.

tools.name: linkedin_company_posts
tools.description: Get recent posts from a LinkedIn company page by URL. Returns posts with engagement metrics (likes, comments, shares, reactions).

tools.name: search_linkedin_companies
tools.description: Search LinkedIn companies by keyword. Returns company name, description, followers, and logo.

tools.name: search_linkedin_jobs
tools.description: Search LinkedIn job listings by keyword. Returns title, company (with company_id), location, posting date, job type, experience level, workplace type, industry, salary, and full description. Filter by recency, job type, company, and location — useful as a hiring/expansion/funding signal.

tools.name: linkedin_job_details

tools.name: truthsocial_user_posts

findings.detail: Description of "list_skills" is 771 chars, far longer than this server's median (127). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
